entities.summary: The Journal on European History of Law is a biannual peer reviewed academic journal covering legal history and Roman law. It was established in 2010 and is published by STS Science Centre on behalf of The European Society for History of Law. The journal contains research articles and book reviews. Articles are published in English and German.
